The existing ot_ts_attribute_map uses Annex 1 internal FGIS field numbers. Public-site search fields are a separate Annex 2 namespace; never join or interpret them by field number without the namespace.

The 28 public Annex 2 search fields contain approval identifiers/status and vehicle identity descriptors (make, commercial name, type, base vehicle/chassis, modifications, category and environmental class), but no engine or gearbox technical designation/code, ECU, DTC, repair or wiring fields. The Annex 1 PDF reference is not a grant to cache or redistribute the PDF. Never infer an engine/gearbox pair from Annex 2 metadata.

The Annex 2 public-site search obligation reviewed in Order 2038 applies to electronically issued records; a metadata export using this public-search namespace must retain field 20 and must not silently treat a missing/false electronic-issuance flag as a publicly searchable record.
